questions.explanation: Needs are things you must have to live and study.

questions.prompt: Grace receives 15 000 FRW and spends 11 500 FRW. How much does she save (FRW)?
The next-best alternative you give up when making a choice is called the…
questions.explanation: Opportunity cost is what you give up.

questions.prompt: "Pay yourself first" means saving before spending on wants.
questions.explanation: Set savings aside as soon as you receive income.

questions.prompt: Your expenses are greater than your income. What should you do first?
questions.explanation: Reduce wants first so that needs are still covered.
